shared_elements: low-relief carved human figures in profile/frontal procession
standing human figure holding a staff or rod
hieratic scene of figures oriented toward a focal point
justification: Both show shallow relief panels with rows of small human figures arranged in horizontal registers, including a standing figure holding a vertical staff and figures processing toward a focal point, and both use a similar flat, low-relief, profile-oriented convention with rows of repeated small figures. The decisive difference is that A is a tribute/procession scene dominated by large rams led by attendants beside a stylized tree, whereas B centres on a winged disc with a raised-arm figure above a platform borne by many small figures, with no animals and with large panels of inscription.
